packs.name: graft-astra-model
packs.summary: Makes gpt-6-astra a first-class model of the running brainstem: injects it into the live model picker and routes its requests to POST {endpoint}/responses, because Astra advertises no /chat/completions route. The grail's endpoint filter is left intact. Requires the graft-engine pack.

packs.name: graft-engine
packs.summary: Discovers, applies and reports grafts - modules that patch the RUNNING brainstem without editing a byte of the grail. Adds the Grafts agent (status / apply / revert / log). Every other graft pack requires this one.

packs.name: graft-hello
packs.summary: The reference graft: adds one marker attribute to the running brainstem and nothing else, so the conformance suite has something trivial to prove idempotence, safe mode and revert against. Requires the graft-engine pack.

packs.name: pack-manager
packs.summary: Install, update, pin, revert and remove brainstem packs from the signed rapp-packs channel — every byte verified before it is written.
